test_T5_model_small: test the T5 small model by computing loss on a text and label batch
test_T5_summarization: test T5 summarization by generating summaries for news articles using beam search
test_T5_translation_en_to_de: test T5 English to German translation using the translation_en_to_de task config
test_T5_translation_en_to_fr: test T5 English to French translation with length penalty and no repeat ngram overrides
test_T5_finetune: test fine-tuning T5 on an overfit task and validate perplexity is below 1.5
